name: Senior bridle maker
design: Very old slender male Yautja with pale beige heavily mottled hide, pronounced broad rear skull, deep forehead creases, four authentic external mandibles with aged ivory tips; extra-long greying scalp tendrils with small bronze bands. Dark wine wrap tunic, ochre narrow leather chest apron, faded black shawl over one shoulder. Examines a single compact alien bridle held between both hands at waist. Bent but balanced relaxed stance, all equipment remains near body.
